## CHLAMYDIAL OR NON-GONOCOCCAL URETHRITIS, CERVICITIS OR PROCTITIS
## Treatment:
## Preferred option (especially for rectal chlamydia or in nonpregnant
## individuals):
## Inpatient

[Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID for 7 days ($) [DI]](psjzid-doxycycline-100mg-po-q12h)
## Preferred in pregnant individuals:
[Azithromycin 1 gm PO ONCE ($) [M]](psjzid-azithromycin-1gm-po-once)
## Outpatient

Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID for 7 days ($) [DI]
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-doxycycline-100mg-po-bid-7ds)
## Preferred for pregnant individuals:
[Azithromycin 1 gm PO x 1 dose ($) [M]](psozid2-azithromycin-1gm-po-once)
Non-VA order for above References:
